Name: OUT-OF-STATE TUITION
Description: Charges to full-time undergraduate students for the full academic year 2024-25 to those students who do not meet the institution's or state's residency requirements. TUITION - Amount of money charged to students for instructional services. Tuition may be charged per term, per course, or per credit. UNDERGRADUATE - A student enrolled in a 4- or 5-year bachelor's degree program, an associate's degree program, or a vocational or technical program below the baccalaureate. FULL-TIME STUDENT Undergraduate - A student enrolled for 12 or more semester credits, or 12 or more quarter credits, or 24 or more clock hours a week each term ACADEMIC YEAR - The period of time generally extending from September to June; usually equated to 2 semesters or trimesters, 3 quarters, or the period covered by a 4-1-4 plan.

Name: Total Enrollment
Description: Total number of men and women enrolled for credit as of the institution's official fall reporting date (October 15). Credit enrollment includes any course or program where attendance can be applied toward a degree, diploma, certificate, or other formal award.

Name: First-time UG Enrollment
Description: Number of first-time, degree/certificate-seeking undergraduate students enrolled for credit in the fall. First-time undergraduates have no prior postsecondary experience and are enrolled in a bachelor's, associate's, or sub-baccalaureate vocational program. Includes students who entered with advanced standing (college credits earned before high school graduation).

Name: UG Degree-Seeking Count
Description: Number of continuing (non-first-year, non-transfer) undergraduate students enrolled for credit and formally recognized by the institution as seeking a degree or certificate.

Name: Asian Enrollment
Description: Number of students enrolled for credit in the fall who identify as Asian — defined as having origins in the Far East, Southeast Asia, or the Indian Subcontinent (e.g., Cambodia, China, India, Japan, Korea, Philippines, Vietnam).

Name: Hispanic Enrollment
Description: Number of students enrolled for credit in the fall who identify as Hispanic or Latino — defined as having Cuban, Mexican, Puerto Rican, South/Central American, or other Spanish cultural origin, regardless of race.

Name: White Enrollment
Description: Number of students enrolled for credit in the fall who identify as White — defined as having origins in Europe, the Middle East, or North Africa.

Name: NHPI Enrollment
Long Name: Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander Enrollment
Description: Number of students enrolled for credit in the fall who identify as Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander — defined as having origins in Hawaii, Guam, Samoa, or other Pacific Islands.

Name: Black/African Enrollment
Description: Number of students enrolled for credit in the fall who identify as Black or African American — defined as having origins in any of the Black racial groups of Africa.

Name: International Enrollment
Description: Number of non-U.S. citizens or nationals enrolled for credit who are present on a visa or temporary basis without the right to remain indefinitely. These students are reported separately and not included in any racial/ethnic category. Permanent residents with legal immigrant status are counted in racial/ethnic categories instead.

Name: 4-Year Bachelor Rate
Description: Percentage of full-time, first-time bachelor's degree-seeking students from the 2018 entering cohort who completed a bachelor's degree within 4 years (100% of normal time). Calculated as: completers within 4 years ÷ (adjusted cohort − allowable exclusions). Allowable exclusions include students who died, became permanently disabled, or left to serve in the armed forces, Peace Corps, or official church missions.

Name: 6-Year Bachelor Rate
Description: Percentage of full-time, first-time bachelor's degree-seeking students from the 2018 entering cohort who completed a bachelor's degree within 6 years (150% of normal time). Calculated as: completers within 6 years ÷ (adjusted cohort − allowable exclusions). Allowable exclusions include students who died, became permanently disabled, or left to serve in the armed forces, Peace Corps, or official church missions.

Name: 6-Year Graduation Rate
Description: Percentage of full-time, degree-seeking undergraduate students from the 2018 entering cohort who completed a bachelor's or an associates degree within 6 years (150% of normal time).

Name: Graduation Rate (Men)
Description: Graduation rate for male first-time, full-time degree/certificate-seeking students within 150% of normal time. For 4-year institutions, uses the 2018 cohort; for 2-year institutions, the 2021 cohort. Calculated as: male completers within 150% of normal time ÷ (adjusted male cohort − allowable exclusions). Allowable exclusions include students who died, became permanently disabled, or left to serve in the armed forces, Peace Corps, or official church missions.

Name: Graduation Rate (Women)
Description: Graduation rate for female first-time, full-time degree/certificate-seeking students within 150% of normal time. For 4-year institutions, uses the 2018 cohort; for 2-year institutions, the 2021 cohort. Calculated as: female completers within 150% of normal time ÷ (adjusted female cohort − allowable exclusions). Allowable exclusions include students who died, became permanently disabled, or left to serve in the armed forces, Peace Corps, or official church missions.

Name: ACT 50th Percentile
Description: Median ACT Composite score among first-time, degree/certificate-seeking undergraduates who submitted ACT scores for admission. The ACT measures academic readiness in English, math, science, and social studies. Reported only for institutions that do not have open admissions.

Name: SAT Verbal 50th Percentile
Long Name: SAT Evidence-Based Reading and Writing 50th Percentile Score
Description: Median SAT Evidence-Based Reading and Writing score among first-time, degree/certificate-seeking undergraduates who submitted SAT scores for admission. Reported only for institutions that do not have open admissions.

Name: SAT Math 50th Percentile
Description: Median SAT Math score among first-time, degree/certificate-seeking undergraduates who submitted SAT scores for admission. Reported only for institutions that do not have open admissions.

Name: Admission Rate
Description: Percentage of applicants admitted. Calculated as: total admissions ÷ total applicants × 100, rounded to the nearest whole number. Only calculated when the applicant count is greater than zero.

Name: Student-Faculty Ratio
Description: Ratio of full-time equivalent (FTE) undergraduates to FTE instructional faculty, excluding graduate/professional programs. FTE students = full-time students + (1/3 × part-time students). FTE faculty = full-time instructional staff + (1/3 × part-time instructional staff). Medical school employees and faculty teaching exclusively in graduate/professional programs (e.g., law, medicine, dentistry) are excluded from both counts.

Name: First-time In-State UG (%)
Long Name: Percent of First-time Undergraduates from In-State
Description: Percentage of first-time, degree/certificate-seeking undergraduates whose permanent address at the time of application was in the same state as the institution. Calculated as: in-state first-time undergraduates ÷ total first-time undergraduates × 100. State of residence reflects the student's permanent address at time of application (e.g., parent's address, driver's license state), not necessarily where their high school was located.

Name: Study Abroad Program
Description: Indicates whether the institution offers a study abroad program — an arrangement where students complete part of their degree studying in another country, either at an overseas campus or through a cooperative agreement with a foreign institution.

Name: Grant Recipients
Description: Number of full-time, first-time degree/certificate-seeking undergraduates who received any federal, state, local, or institutional grant aid during the year.

Name: Grant Aid Total
Long Name: Total Grant Aid Awarded (Full-time, First-time Undergraduates)
Description: Total dollar amount of federal, state, local, and institutional grant aid awarded to full-time, first-time degree/certificate-seeking undergraduates during the year.

Name: UG Pell Recipients
Description: Number of degree/certificate-seeking undergraduates who received a Federal Pell Grant — a need-based federal grant program (under Title IV of the Higher Education Act) for students who have not yet earned a bachelor's degree.

Name: Federal Loan Recipients
Description: Number of undergraduates who received federal student loans, including Title IV subsidized and unsubsidized loans. Excludes PLUS loans made directly to parents.

Name: Application Fee
Description: Dollar amount charged to process an undergraduate student's application for admission. This fee is non-refundable and cannot be applied toward tuition or other required fees.

Name: Doctor - Highest Degree
Description: The highest type of degree offered is one of the following: Doctor's degree - research/scholarship, Doctor's degree - professional practice, Doctor's degree - research/scholarship and professional practice, Doctor's degree - other

Name: Master - Highest Degree
Description: The highest type of degree offered is Master's degree

Name: HBCU
Description: Indicates whether the institution is designated as an HBCU — defined under the Higher Education Act as an institution established before 1964 whose principal mission is the education of Black Americans and which holds recognized accreditation or is making reasonable progress toward it.

Name: No Religious Affiliation
Description: Indicates whether the institution has no religious affiliation. Derived from IPEDS's religious affiliation/denomination variable for private not-for-profit institutions.

Name: NCAA Member
Description: Indicates whether the institution is a member of the National Collegiate Athletic Association (NCAA).

Name: Carnegie R1/R2
Long Name: Carnegie Classification: R1 or R2 Research University
Description: Indicates whether the institution is classified under the 2025 Carnegie Classification as a research university with either Very High Spending and Doctorate Production (R1) or High Spending and Doctorate Production (R2).

Name: Carnegie Research Colleges
Long Name: Carnegie Classification: Research College or University
Description: Indicates whether the institution is classified as a Research College or University under the 2025 Carnegie Classification.

Name: Carnegie Academic Program Mix
Long Name: Carnegie Classification: Undergraduate Academic Program Mix
Description: Undergraduate academic program mix classification from the 2025 Carnegie Classification system, reflecting the balance of program types offered at the undergraduate level.

Name: For-Profit
Description: Indicates whether the institution is a private for-profit school (as opposed to private not-for-profit). Only applicable to private institutions.
